column5: Same hub, same component; the ONLY differences from the base are the card previews and one tier badge. ★★★ ESCALATION 1 — TIER BADGES, DO NOT RESOLVE IN A PARITY PASS. Measured 2026-08-26 off the label rows (Frame 1000003849, icons/tiers Type variant + the tier word), all five cards, both frames: base = Gold/Gold/FREE/Gold/Gold, ALT = Gold/Gold/GOLD/Gold/Gold, SCREEN_TIERS = bronze/silver/bronze/silver/bronze. So the two frames disagree on News AND BOTH FRAMES DISAGREE WITH THE CODE ON ALL FIVE — this is not "one badge differs", it is "the frames badge four screens Gold that a Bronze/Silver subscriber can open today". A tier badge is an entitlement claim, so the hub renders SCREEN_TIERS (the code's value) via TIER_PRICING[tier].display + SkaiIcon tier-<tier>, the same map ScreenGate gates on, and the padlock uses the same isScreenLocked helper so badge and gate cannot drift. Guarded by IntelligentSupportHub.test.tsx with the tiers written as literals (independent oracle) — mutation-checked: hardcoding "Gold" fails "badges each card with the SCREEN_TIERS tier" at getByText("Bronze"), and the medal stayed BRONZE while the word said Gold, i.e. the frames' values would visibly contradict their own artwork. If the frames are the intended pricing, screenTiers.ts is the one file that changes and every gate follows. ★ ESCALATION 2 — PREVIEW STYLE, resolved from artwork as the brief asked: BASE treatment, not this ALT's. Two measurements decide it. (1) This frame's previews are whole 1440x900 screens in a 428.667x167 pane = 0.298 scale, at which the screens' 14px body text rasterises to ~4px — unreadable, and confirmed by render. (2) BOTH variants' previews carry fabricated content: this one bakes in "$112,076.07" and a "Unitree Robotics surges 460%" headline; the base's NEWS card draws a Fear & Greed + Altcoin-season gauge, which belongs to Sentiment. Neither pane is a data surface, so neither is transcribed: the pane ships as the frame's Green Coal 100 wash carrying the destination's own glyph, no numbers and no synthesised series. Upgrading a pane to a genuine live mini later is additive and must go through that screen's real hook plus its offline state.

The 428.667x249 hub card. ★ CORRECTION to status.home-2.tsv row 140, which calls it "the hub CARD component": it is a loose FRAME parked directly on the page (parent type PAGE, name "✅ Home 2"), NOT a COMPONENT — there is no variant set, so there are no card states to read off it. One divergence NOT copied: in the base frame only the Market intel tile is #56C7F3 (sky-blue) and the other four are green-coal-100, while the ALT makes all five green-coal-100; a lone sky-blue tile with no state to justify it reads as a leftover, so all five ship green-coal-100.
